windfield.label: Model forecast (Proposed)
windfield.model: Open-Meteo best_match: the best model Open-Meteo has for each node (the answer does not name it)

grid.order: row major from the south west corner: node = j * nx + i, i along longitude (east), j along latitude (north); node latitude = lat0 + j * dlat, node longitude = lon0 + i * dlon

windfield.convention: direction is where the wind comes FROM, degrees clockwise from north; u is toward the east and v toward the north: u = -speed * sin(direction), v = -speed * cos(direction); a wind from the north (0) has v negative, a wind from the east (90) has u negative; calm is a speed of 0 and gives u = 0 and v = 0; a speed with no direction gives null; u, v and gust are whole numbers in steps of 0.1 km/h (divide by 10 for km/h); a node or an hour with no reading is null, never 0

stationsNote: the stations are airports, not the rain points; METAR wind is a 10 minute mean in whole knots, temperature and dew point are whole degrees, pressure is the QNH in whole hPa; a gust is in a report only when it passes the mean by 10 kt (0.1 to 0.7 percent of reports), so no gust means none reported, never calm; relative humidity is worked out from temperature and dew point (Magnus: RH = 100 * exp(17.625 * Td / (243.04 + Td)) / exp(17.625 * T / (243.04 + T)), Recomputed) and is good to a few points
comparisonNote: each point has the station nearest to it (nearestStation, with the distance); comparison is model minus observed at the hour of the latest report (Recomputed): temperature in deg C, relative humidity in %, wind (the 10 minute mean) and gust in km/h, pressure (QNH) in hPa; the observed gust is the peak of the report, the higher of the mean and a reported gust; the station is an airport, so a difference is partly place and height, not only model error
